semantics.missingRequirements: Missing requirements remain explicit and arrays are never defaulted to empty to imply completion.
semantics.approvals: Any approval remains independently explicit; no workflow dependency, automatic grant, cleanup, financial/owner/price/runtime-code/funded-execution restriction is introduced.
